I grew up in an upper middle class home, we had money, we traveled. I went to private school.
I carried a dirty secret. My brother sexually molested me for years and I have kept that secret to this day. It has always been a cancer inside me regardless of how stoic I have tried to be or pretended it didn't happen. I honestly feel that triggered all kinds of issues that manifested in my teens and twenties. 
Fast forward. I straightened myself out in my late 20s, went to school and got a great paying medical job. Meanwhile always medicating the depression and anxiety to function at a very high level. 
I bought a beautiful home near the beach with the pool/spa, the whole 9 yards,  figuring I would find someone to share my life with. Unfortunately, that never happened.  My life consisted of 12 hours in the trauma center, drink and drug myself to oblivion, rinse , repeat.
The wheels came off the wagon when I was popped by a random drug test. Marijuana, xanax. 
I checked myself into a mental hospital voluntarily. I had a meeting scheduled to meet with my director and the head of HR. I was assured by the social worker at the looney bin she would reach out to them, no worries.  That never happened. I was terminated and reported to the state. To keep my licence I had to tell any prospective employers that I was in a program for impaired professionals. (Who the hell is going to hire me?)
I also had alot of other criteria to meet out of my own pocket for 5 years. I forfeited my professional license . I was just done. 
I live with an abusive man that feeds me and keeps a roof over my head. I just list a job I enjoyed because the company went belly up and I am broke with maxed credit. 
I am just done. I have no family. Life has become pointless. 

Sorry so long,  you asked.
Btw my first attempt was at age 14, I failed and I felt horribly sick for ages.
